result.title: Understanding Backdoor Attacks in Scene Graph Generation via Global Context Pathway
result.comment: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
result.summary: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) produces structured scene representations, yet its training-time backdoor risk remains unexplored. Unlike classification, SGG exposes a pair-level attack surface that enables selective corruption of relations involving a designated object category. However, because SGG largely relies on localized evidence, globally placed triggers may face difficulty in manipulating such predictions. Recent SGG architectures increasingly incorporate global context to improve scene modeling, which may in turn facilitate such attacks. In this paper, we systematically study this backdoor risk and investigate the role of the global context pathway in backdoor behavior. Concretely, we first instantiate this attack with an effective method, and propose a three-axis evaluation protocol to characterize backdoor behavior. Experiments on Visual Genome with representative open-vocabulary and closed-set SGG models demonstrate the effectiveness of the attack. Mechanistic analyses reveal that the explicit global context pathway serves as a major carrier of the backdoor effect across the evaluated SGG models. In particular, replacing the poisoned global context representation with its clean counterpart during inference sharply suppresses the attack, yielding 100% and 97% reductions in attack success for the OvSGTR family and RelationFormer, respectively. Moreover, training-time interventions in the OvSGTR family show that suppressing trigger signals in this pathway either reduces attack success or substantially degrades utility. Together, these findings suggest that explicit global context designs may pose a backdoor risk in SGG architectures.

AI.brief_summary: 该文系统研究 Scene Graph Generation 的训练期后门风险，提出一种针对特定物体类别关系的攻击方法与三轴评估协议，并在 Visual Genome 上验证；通过替换或抑制 global context 通路表示，定位该通路是后门效应的主要载体。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及 latent reasoning，但其「用干净表示替换内部通路以测因果贡献」的干预式机制分析，可供核查用于判断 VLM 推理中 latent 视觉表征是否真正被使用，以及全局上下文旁路是否绕过局部证据。
